subject: 元北方护运行货栈（原创扩展）
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct only this Yuan cargo depot courtyard GROUND GEOMETRY. Both base edges now are too steep. Lower camera pitch slightly so BOTH visible ground diagonals slopes become exactly+0.500 and-0.500, angle26.565degrees. Make the left-to-front edge14 units and front-to-right11 units, ratio1.273; current is too square. Retain exact northern Yuan architecture, clay plaster enclosure, simple gray roof, sacks, handcart and depot appearance. Redraw all parallel walls/roof ridges to corresponding axes; verticals remain vertical. No nonphysical distortion. Ground is one flat thin rectangle, clearly visible left/front/right corners, no raised platform. True transparent RGBA, full subject with10% margins, upper-left light short lower-right shadow, no lettering, people, greenery or added objects.
negative: 文字、伪字、人物、现代物、天空、地平线、棋盘格、背景建筑、大阴影、厚地台、清式宫廷装饰、透视消失点、裁切。

notes: 第二候选宽深比改善但右轴仍偏陡；护运行用货栈外观（原创扩展），无字号；保留candidate几何警告。
